### Events

| Name             | Payload | Description                                               |
| ---------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
| `update`         | —       | Emitted when the version card's update button is clicked. |
| `reimported`     | —       | Emitted after a successful configuration re-import.       |
| `reimport-error` | —       | Emitted when a configuration re-import fails.             |
